Of the 46 remaining items, "alive" is the best splitter I can find, so I'm estimating how each candidate divides them.

Alive items: bee, butterfly, cactus, cat, chicken, cow, dog, dolphin, eagle, elephant, frog, goldfish, horse, oak tree, penguin, rose, seaweed, shark, snake, spider, sunflower, and arguably grass. That is about 22 of 46, which is close to even.

"Is it an animal?" would give roughly 5 non-animal alive items plus the non-living ones. The animals are bee, butterfly, cat, chicken, cow, dog, dolphin, eagle, elephant, frog, goldfish, horse, penguin, shark, snake, and spider. That is 16 of 46, so it is less even than "alive".

I'm going with "alive".
